mara: quick heads-up — onboarding sampleapp is spitting out invalid embeddings for rerank tests. Node SDK returns 1536 but python sample sends 1535 sometimes.
kevin: ugh. any repro steps? is it deterministic or flaky with retries?
mara: flaky. mostly on auth refresh paths. sequence: user token expires, refreshes via sdk, next batch call duplicates one item and the returned vector drops a dim.
ryan: can you paste the exact error from the API?
mara: here is the server log snippet: 
```
[2026-02-18T14:02:03Z] ERROR: embeddings.retriever: bad request - dims mismatch expected=1536 got=1535 for batch_id=ab12
```
kevin: that log matches a bug I saw where the Node batching helper concatenates arrays then slices incorrectly when an auth retry triggers a re-enqueue. basically off-by-one due to `endIndex - 1` in the splice logic. :facepalm:
mara: any short-term workaround? customers onboarding now.
ryan: temp fix: validate each vector length right before sending and drop+log the bad ones rather than retrying everything. also avoid retries that requeue the same item more than once. I'll open a tiny helper patch.
kevin: patch idea: in the batching helper add `validateBatchShapes(batch, expectedDim)` and on failure return 400 with context instead of retrying. That prevents duplicate calls and makes failures clearer for SDKs.
mara: that would help. also the python sampleapp pads vectors to 0s when it sees length mismatch — we should align behavior: fail fast in SDKs, sampleapps should not auto-pad unless explicitly enabled.
kevin: agreement. SDK parity action: Node & Python should both expose `strictShape` flag (default true) for embeddings/rerank helpers. when false, allow pad/trim with a warning.
ryan: I'll file an internal RFC and link the PR. also adding a unit test that simulates auth refresh mid-batch would catch this.
devex-bot: New issue created: DE-1427 "batching helper: validate shapes, avoid duplicate requeue on auth retry" (link: https://git.internal/redwood/issues/DE-1427) :robot_face:
kevin: quick snippet for the guard — can we add this to samples asap?
```js
function validateBatchShapes(vecs, expected) {
  for (let i = 0; i < vecs.length; i++) {
    if (vecs[i].length !== expected) {
      return {ok: false, idx: i, got: vecs[i].length};
    }
  }
  return {ok: true};
}
```
mara: testing locally now with strictShape=true, will report back. thanks all. :pray:
deploy-bot: Hotfix deployed to devex-helpers (canary) — rollout 10%
mara: seeing green for the small repro. I'll coordinate with docs to call out the default strict behavior in onboarding guide.
kevin: follow-up: later we should add telemetry metric `embed_invalid_dim` so support can surface onboarding friction quickly.
mara: yes please. closing the loop once docs + sampleapp updated.
